    rid3 = v.begin("q3")
    assert rid1 == 1
    assert rid2 == 2
    assert rid3 == 3

    """Test that finishing with old ID returns False"""
    v = View()
    rid1 = v.begin("q1")
    rid2 = v.begin("q2")

    assert rid2 == 2
    # Try to finish with rid1 after rid2 started
    result = v.finish(rid1, ["old"])
    assert result == False
    # Verify rows are still from the latest valid operation
    result2 = v.finish(rid2, ["new"])
    assert result2 == True
    assert v.rows == ["new"]

    """Test that finishing with same ID twice returns False after first success"""
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("q1")
    result1 = v.finish(rid, ["first"])
    assert result1 == True
    # Try to finish again with same ID
    result2 = v.finish(rid, ["second"])
    assert result2 == False
    assert v.rows == ["first"]
